verdict.rationale: Twenty provides most of the building blocks. Its REST/GraphQL API supports record updates and batching, and an MCP server is listed on every plan. Google and Microsoft email and calendar events sync onto CRM records, and AI agents and workflow AI-agent steps can execute multi-step tasks on record changes or webhooks. However, the evidence never shows an agent turning email or meeting signals into deal-stage or next-step updates; this has to be assembled by the user, and emails are documented as linking to Company and People records rather than opportunities. Missing for 10: documented email/meeting-to-opportunity linkage, a worked example of an agent updating deal stages from those signals, MCP server documentation beyond a pricing-table line, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline updates.
